take: Per the Jets' announcement, defenseman Elias Salomonsson was reinstated from non-roster injured reserve and assigned to Manitoba of the AHL. In his two games for Winnipeg this season he averaged just over 19 minutes, and the team controlled 52% of the 5-on-5 chances (expected goals share, a measure of shot quality) while he was on the ice, about 6 points better than without him. Since he is headed to the AHL, going by how the coach has used his players, Haydn Fleury (16:46 a night) would be next in line for any minutes Salomonsson leaves open.
